summary: Craft re-invoked at /impeccable craft before any site-code modification in this repair run (attempt 2). Re-loaded the locally provisioned Impeccable skill: ran scripts/context.mjs (PRODUCT.md + DESIGN.md loaded), read reference/craft.md and the brand register (reference/brand.md), and re-confirmed the existing compositional thesis rather than designing anew: 'O Diagnóstico do Palco' — a two-audience decision system where the stage becomes a diagnostic instrument. The harness lacks native image generation, so craft.md Step 3 mock generation is skipped per its own fallback and the DESIGN.md direction is treated as the visual contract. Evidence boundary re-verified against prospect.json/PRODUCT.md/BRAND_SOURCE.md: only verified facts (name, founder Heverson Barbosa, taglines, service list, Curitiba address, stage/filmed-practice cues, diagnostic-first intent) are used; contradictory year counts, enrollment totals, NPS, awards, and outcome multipliers remain deliberately absent. Deliverable tier remains early_visual_direction; not production-complete, not ready for publication, no approval or publication receipts written.
